verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents creating branded, compliant invoices and matching invoices to bank payments, which gives some view of when they are paid. Sending by email or post is documented only for quotes and dunning notices, not invoices explicitly. Missing for 10: online payment options (pay links or payment gateways) on invoices, tracking of when an invoice is viewed, explicit invoice sending by email, a real-time paid-status notification, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can create and send invoices with online payment options and see when they are viewed and paid

citations.quote: You create quotes and invoices in your own design fulfilling all mandatory information.
Map invoices directly to your bank payments.
Create a dunning notice for an overdue invoice and send it directly from sevdesk.
